purpose: Govern leakage-safe live calibration and champion/challenger promotion without automatic production mutation.
locked_rules: Sportsbook and market data are prohibited from calibration tuning inputs.
Frozen forecasts are immutable and must never be rewritten by calibration.
Settled outcomes may evaluate prior forecasts but may only tune future model versions.
The observation used to fit a challenger cannot also score that challenger.
No challenger may become the production champion automatically.
No calibration adjustment may mutate True Value, comparison winners, prior forecasts, or historical settlements in place.
All governance decisions are append-only and retain evidence counts and metric snapshots.
